ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green cubes with smooth, slightly translucent skin edges and firm, moist-looking flesh, cut into roughly 2-2.5 cm pieces, clustered in the upper-left of the plate; a few small dark seeds/bits scattered among them | 110
ITEM 2 | Brown-red grains, short and slightly sticky-looking, with a matte, grainy texture, mixed with bits of green and pale strands; sits in the lower-left center of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Bright green slender spears, about 0.5 cm thick and 6-8 cm long, lightly glossy with a slight oily sheen, some with pale yellowish tips; mixed among the grains at lower-left | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark green arugula-type leaves, ruffled and fresh-looking with a slight sheen, covering roughly a third of the plate on the right side; a few small dark round pieces (olives or similar) and small pale chunks scattered within | 85
